# HolyCrab Agent Tools v0.7.2

Add Kling 4.0/Flash and MiniMax H3 Image/Highspeed to CLI, MCP and Skills, bringing the shared catalog to 22 models. Support Seedance 2.5 480p drafts and conversion to 1080p finals with confirmed-price binding, existing-final reuse and protection against automatically repeating uncertain submissions.

Asset availability follows the consuming model: non-Seedance models are no longer blocked solely by Ark review, while Seedance keeps its review requirements. Workflows report explicit material failures and defer processing materials.

Skill content version is 1.0.2, requiring CLI 0.7.2 or later. Configuration, installation choices, workflow records and submission history are retained. Installers and bundles use the shared runtime inventory and SHA-256 checksums. Windows retains native DPAPI credential handling.

Validation includes independent code review, automated HTTP and upgrade/rollback checks, and six explicitly approved live generations: four new models, a draft and its final. These completed and downloaded; existing-final reuse made zero write requests. Live reference/voice inputs and balance-difference settlement were not verified. Generate backend code was not changed. Audio 1.5 and video upscaling remain deferred.
